visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long hair, wearing a lavender cardigan and a beige beanie, sits next to a man in a yellow vest on a tan sofa. She smiles and talks toward the camera. (2) The woman holds a white drawing board and starts sketching a cartoon character with a marker. The man watches her attentively while nodding. (3) She reveals the finished drawing: a cartoon girl in a dress with a large hat. The man points to the ears of the drawing, gesturing towards her own head. (4) The man points to the hat and the top of the drawing's head, comparing sizes while the woman laughs and touches her beanie. (5) He points to the eyes of the drawing, which are solid black circles. The woman listens intently with a concerned expression. (6) He gestures towards the waist of the drawing, tracing its thin outline. The woman makes a surprised and slightly sad face. (7) The two characters laugh together as the man concludes his explanation. (8) They both wave and smile at the camera as the video ends, with a summary list appearing next to them.
